snapshot_md5.unit: md5 of the snapshot colour dump

dimensions.scene: city/chase/fountain/greets/crash - every measurement is per scene
dimensions.pose: the t= of a snapshot or the cam name (camA/camB/H6017): pins and his marks are pose-specific (T5: chase pins are pose-SEQUENCE dependent)
dimensions.arm: the flag set a render was judged/measured under (judging, default, shoulder_plateau, prefo, fixcam, ship, r3...): the same wall under two arms is two claims
dimensions.defect: wall/floor/tears/bulge - a lever refuted 'as a wall lever' must keep that word (F3: cpb)
dimensions.granularity: kernel_row/whole_frame/binary - the placement floor applies per kernel row, not per frame (F7)
dimensions.state: a BULGE_CORPUS state number, so a detector reading and his label join on it (fixture 5)
dimensions.detector: gbi/sweep/sgm/blackpx/geomxsec/refdiff - which instrument a validity claim or reading is about
dimensions.flag: a FeatureFlags.def name - refutations and look decisions are about a flag
dimensions.row: a TailProf row name (lighting-w1, Tick-ReflXfrm, cones-call) - per-row costs and floors
dimensions.recipe: a pin recipe (city_deferred, chase_default, chase_cinematic, greets_t1588, greets_acceptance, render_gate) - one md5 per (recipe, pose)
dimensions.tool: the instrument or program a trap is about (pgrep, warm_gate.sh, tear_battery.sh, zsh, git, DisplaceStoneSubdiv)
dimensions.head: auto-captured git commit; tip_ref is fog-wt (the integration branch), so worktree records are neither older nor at tip until merged

comments.contracts: snapshot_md5 is strict: shared engine machinery changes only by a new md5 proof. look is judged: his eye; an md5 pin is weight 1 there (2026-08-13: byte gates are instruments, not vetoes). Numeric contracts carry the campaign's ladder: min-of-11 interleaved with a duplicate arm is the top; a single run is 3.
comments.humans: gil-ad is the OS username (home /Users/gil-ad, git author Gil-Ad Ben Or): a person typing at the keyboard leaves GROUNDWORK_WRITER unset and is identified by that name; the coordinator records his words verbatim with a date; the earlier 'gilad' was an invention and is gone.

Script: .groundwork/seed/seed_2026-08-29.py
comments.code_paths: a record is older-than-tip only if fog-wt changed one of these since the record's commit; docs/, tools/, .groundwork/ and images do not re-open a measurement (the rev-kb seeding merge is docs-only and must not unverify the 00v baselines)
